Subject: Trainers wanted - 5-day Data Engineering + SQL bootcamp, three cities, March 2027

Hello smallTech team,

Initech Analytics is rolling out an internal data upskilling programme and we are looking for
trainers to deliver a 5-day onsite bootcamp on Data Engineering and SQL. We will run one cohort
each in Bengaluru, Pune and Hyderabad, India, at our client delivery centres, with around 25
analysts per cohort. A trainer may take one cohort or several.

Our head office is in Mumbai, but no sessions will be held there. The programme manager joins
from Chennai over Zoom for the kick-off and the final demo day only; nobody attends in Chennai.

Content we need: SQL from joins to window functions, data modelling, building batch ELT pipelines,
orchestration basics and data quality checks. Participants know Excel and some SQL; labs on a
cloud warehouse are expected every day.

Fee: Rs 15,000 per day per trainer. Venue, lunch and local travel are covered by us.
The cohorts start on 1 March 2027 and run Monday to Friday.

Please reply with your profile and the cohort(s) you can take.

Regards,
